items.title: Anthropic outlined memory for autonomous agents
items.oneliner: Anthropic wants agents to tag, replay, and reorganize experience during idle time. Memory is becoming a product surface.

items.title: A 31B video model got compressed
items.oneliner: HyperFlow shrank a 31B video-audio model to 14B, 6 steps, INT8. Multimodal generation is getting cheaper fast.

items.title: A cheaper judge matched Opus accuracy
items.oneliner: Hightouch says Jev plus selective Opus calls matches Opus accuracy at 4x lower cost. Cascades are winning.

items.title: Researchers demonstrated a Firecracker VM escape
items.oneliner: A Firecracker escape reached host root from a microVM. Sandbox assumptions around untrusted code just got shakier.

items.title: Meta smartglasses were hacked through firmware
items.oneliner: A researcher pulled OTA firmware from Meta Ray-Bans and achieved arbitrary code execution. Wearables remain soft targets.

items.title: Web frameworks still overtrust forwarded headers
items.oneliner: Rails and Spring stacks can trust spoofed Forwarded headers by default. Cache poisoning and fake client IPs follow.

items.title: Reddit comments can steer AI search
items.oneliner: Cornell found a 13-word comment can sway AI answers. Retrieval pipelines are easier to game than teams admit.

items.title: GitHub rebuilt Git storage for scale
items.oneliner: GitHub says its new architecture handles 7,200 pushes per second and 5,000 agents. Developer infrastructure is being re-architected.

items.title: Libghostty reached a stable 1.0 API
items.oneliner: Libghostty 1.0 ships ABI stability after landing in products reaching 12.5 million users. Terminal infrastructure is consolidating.

items.title: Musl Linux got closer to NVIDIA support
items.oneliner: Chimera Linux is narrowing the gap between musl and proprietary NVIDIA drivers. Alternative distros still live under GPU constraints.
